scope: Later tasks created through the existing running-controller handover can retain their original reopening context, appear in plan-only discovery, and use the existing safe same-boot reopening path. Component validation only.
main_path: Real TaskAdmission reservation and ordinary worker preparation bind the original context to the later task's own plan and checkpoint.
The existing paused handover startup records its original deadline; the retained desktop host lock refuses another owner.
Discovery reads the explicit handover plan path without opening SQLite or querying boot state, and leaves task bytes unchanged.
Real Recovery, TaskStore, admission and cooperative Stop callbacks preserve a confirmed input read and known undispatched request.
The existing composition reopens the same task paused, invokes no new preparation, and preserves its deadline, counters, pending request and history.
A fresh Resume includes the exact saved read in its first provider request, produces one physical output write and accepts the task.
Reading the completed saved result reports zero provider calls and leaves task database bytes unchanged.
Later tasks prepared without original reopening context retain legacy behavior and remain unlisted; no context or deadline is backfilled.

predecessor_regression.source: Exact committed predecessor src/tests archive with only the new regression test added.
predecessor_regression.observed_failure: The actual handover-prepared plan lacked adaptive_inference.desktop_reopen.v1; the new context-persistence assertion raised KeyError before later reopening steps.

retained_intermediate_checks.scope_limit: Both batches also discovered 13 existing CompositionTests through a direct class import. The import was changed to module-qualified fixture reuse before the final batch, which exposes exactly two new tests. Original successful receipts remain retained and are not counted as additional new coverage.

limits: Provider transport, process, GUI and native-resource edges are inert fixtures. The native conversation projection uses real SQLite but does not execute the installed Hermes SDK.
The new fixture produces a format-checked notes output, not the physically qualified IQ3_S inventory result or a model-quality/performance measurement.
A task prepared but never started has no saved execution deadline. Discovery does not authorize continuation or create a replacement budget.
The separate additive lineage record preserves historical sources; this affected batch is not a combined full suite, package verification or hosted CI result.
No installed later-task restart, OS reboot, foreground quality or broader M5 acceptance is claimed. Earlier physical evidence remains bound to its original runtime source.
